name: model-hierarchy
title_zh: 任务一冒头就替你挑便宜模型的调度员
tagline_zh: 同样跑一个任务，GPT-4o 能干的活儿别让 o1 上。按复杂度自动分级路由。
tagline_en: Don't pay o1 for what GPT-4o can do. Auto-routes by task complexity, slashes API spend enough to fund ten more.
desc_en: Cost-optimize AI agent operations by routing tasks to appropriate models based on complexity. Use this skill when: (1) deciding which model to use for a task, (2) spawning sub-agents, (3) considering cost efficiency, (4) the current model feels like overkill for the task. Triggers: "model routing", "cost optimization", "which model", "too expensive", "spawn agent".
why_zh: 它不看你说了什么，看你任务里藏了几层推理。能拆成子任务就派小模型打前站。
why_en: It ignores your wording, measures hidden reasoning depth. Subtasks go to small models first; only real puzzles reach the.
limit_zh: 只做模型选择决策，不执行任务本身；需要你已配置多个可用模型及各自价格；对单步简单任务无优化空间，反而多一次路由开销。
limit_en: Decides only, never executes. Needs multiple configured models with prices. No gain on trivial single-step tasks—adds one routing call overhead.
title_en: A dispatcher that picks the cheap model the moment a task.
